msg: Strange Device ported to the Rust stack + balance-tuned in lockstep with TS; non-decisive games 41.5% → ~1.7%.
Parity re-baselined for the Device mechanic — 8/8 golden traces PASS.
Decisiveness study: hard_vs_hard §10 outcome-cause breakdown + tile-majority tiebreak. Device-win ~40%, Device-survival ~50%.

Phase D done: trainer + benchmark emit the §10/§10.1 ★top-5 metrics; dashboard renders the 'Voittotavat' win-cause-by-side panel, policy entropy, value calibration, Device build/survival, win-rate by seat + CI, intent histogram. Verified in browser.

BuildStrangeDevice added as a neural intent: INTENT_COUNT 11→12, policy input 63→64 (network-breaking, intended). Mirrored TS→Rust; parity re-baselined GREEN 8/8. Shipped weights.ts widened 63→64 by transplant (live client keeps ~old strength).
Live game-replay viewer added: trainer dumps one champion-vs-hard game to replay.json every 5 iters; dashboard animates the board (play/scrub/speed).
AlphaZero training launched (cheap 64-dim experiment on the decisive game): iters 800, games 48, sims 64, value-MCTS leaf, bench every 5. iter 0 = 32.5% vs hard.
Watching the live replay surfaced 3 issues: replay used a FIXED seed (same map every time), HQ placement was top-left/corner-biased, and rivers were not visible. Training paused to fix.

Fixes: replay map seed now varies per recording (HQs spread out, e.g. (1,6)+(11,1) instead of both top-left); terrain (river/mountain/forest) drawn on the board; default playback speed set to 4×. Also created build-status.json + build-log.jsonl so this Rakennusprosessi tab is populated.

Found + fixed two benchmark-integrity bugs in the Hard bot (the shipped CPU too): HQ placement could pick the unowned Mikontalo tile (building present → placement refused → 0 tiles → instant loss, 3.4% of maps) and the bot self-bankrupted on grassland-poor maps (built farms down to ~0 cash before their ~4-round payout, 2.6%). Fixes: HQ candidates must be EMPTY+unowned (grassland→non-river→any fallback); affordsFarm keeps a moneyDrain*4 cushion. TS+Rust lockstep, parity re-baselined 8/8. Re-scan: no-HQ 3.4%->0%, self-bankrupt 2.6%->~0%.

Added AI-vs-AI (self-play) replay + a viewer toggle (AI vs Hard CPU / AI vs AI); both refresh every 5 iters with their own random seed. Also: replay map seed now varies per recording, terrain (river/mountain/forest) drawn, default speed 4×.
Training PAUSED for a clean handoff (user starts a fresh session). All gates green: npm test 69, tsc, parity 8/8, hard-bot scan clean. Ready to relaunch (cheap 64-dim AZ experiment).
